findings.statement: NVIDIA's portfolio already covers accelerators, NVLink interconnect, Spectrum-X networking and an inference software stack, which are the components of a rack-scale platform.
NVIDIA's own price list for GPUs, networking and software is the baseline from which a bundled subscription-plus-hardware price must be built.
Delivery capacity for system integration, enterprise support and field engineering bounds how many enterprise customers can be onboarded at launch.
Supply availability of accelerators, networking components and rack-level power and cooling design constrains launch volume and timing.
Enterprise packaging gaps, such as simplified deployment, managed operations and a subscription billing model, must be closed before a mid-size enterprise launch.
The existing partner and OEM channel is a route to reach mid-size enterprises and regional cloud providers without building a new direct sales force.

metadata.source_note: All six expected items are supported only by the explicitly fictional scenario assumptions in context/synthetic_internal_brief.json.
